entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R. Case No.1331 of 2022 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.(P), Kujang arising out of Paradeep Lock P.S. Case No.429 of 2022 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 420/341/323/294/379/506/34 of I.P.C.
3.

entities.text: Paradeep Lock P.S. Case No.429 of 2022
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
District & Sessions Judge, Kujang by order dated 22.02.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 27.12.2022 on the accusation of duping the Informant of Rs.3 lakhs on the assurance of arranging the plot for him.

5. It is further submitted that since charge sheet has already been filed on 1.3.2023 and the allegation is based on documents and the Petitioner is the first offender, further continuance of the Petitioner in custody is not warranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that there has been seizure of money receipt which indicates the complicity of the Petitioner and his wife.

7. Taking into account the nature of allegation and that the Petitioner is the first offender, as stated,

entities.text: Rabindra Sahoo vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin subject to verification of criminal antecedent of similar nature.
8. If it comes to fore that the Petitioner has any such criminal antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.

9. Additionally it is directed that the Petitioner shall furnish unencumbered property security to the tune of Rs.5,00,000/- (rupees five lakhs) to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin, which shall abide by the final outcome of the case at hand.
10. The BLAPL thus stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
